title: A caliper readout pill draws whole at the edge of its layer
goal: The room Photonz reserves for a measurement readout is two pixels shorter than the pill it actually draws at the default label size, so the pill's outermost border pixel can be shaved off in an exported picture when the readout sits past the end of its caliper. The reserved height should match the real pill so exports are never clipped.
notes: MeasureContent.estimatedLabelSize (Sources/PhotonzCore/Measure.swift) uses labelPointSize * 1.3 for the line box; TextRasterizer.naturalSize measures SF Pro at 1.444 em at 18 pt, 1.667 em at 9 pt, 1.22 em at 90 pt. The alignment branch already uses labelPointSize * 1.2 + 5, which holds at every size (AlignmentChipTests.theReservationHoldsTheRealTextForEveryWording). The caliper branch was left alone on 2026-09-02 because it ships in Current and a taller reservation nudges clearingHeadOffset for horizontal calipers; decide whether that is acceptable. MeasureBuilder.layer unions the chip rect without renderPadding, so the frame ends exactly at the reserved edge.
acceptance: A rendered caliper with its readout past the end shows the pill's full border on every side in the exported pixels, at label sizes 8, 18 and 90 px.
The PhotonzRender suite has a test comparing the reserved chip size with the real pill footprint for calipers, the way AlignmentChipTests does for guides.
Existing caliper placement and clearing-head tests still pass, or their pinned numbers are updated with a note saying why.
Because this changes shared code, the current release gets the same fix and the change is noted in the progress log.

log.note: Reproduced with a new PhotonzRender test (CaliperChipTests): real pill 42 px tall vs 40 reserved at 18 px, 21.1 vs 18 at 8 px; at 90 px the old 1.3 em already held. Stroke 3 at 8 px also spilled 1 px sideways: the border is stroked centered on the pill edge, so half of it lies outside the reserved rect.

Adversarial look at the idea: no UX choice here, an export that shaves a border is simply wrong. Fix is the alignment chip rule (1.2 em + 5) for the caliper line box plus a chipRenderPadding (stroke/2 + 1) applied in MeasureBuilder.layer, mirroring renderPadding for the legs. clearingHeadOffset nudges 31 -> 32.5 px at the default size; that is the honest standoff for a 42 px pill and no pinned test moved, so it was decided here rather than as a decision card.

Verified: CaliperChipTests renders the caliper with 40 px of room on every side and asserts every inked pixel lands inside the reserved frame, both orientations, label 8/18/90 px, stroke 1 and 3. Export path (DocumentRenderer) rasterizes at layer.frame.size, so the same frame bounds the export. Next has no forked measure code, so the shared fix reaches both releases. Full suite 1287 green.

Caliper chip reservation now matches the real pill: line box 1.2em+5 plus stroke padding in MeasureBuilder.layer (shared PhotonzCore, so Current and Next). Verified by new CaliperChipTests (pixel-level, label 8/18/90 px, stroke 1 and 3); 1287 tests green.
